ask.jsonl.note: command agent asks the owner with the ask tool of deck and hands in the color with result_submit; the fake makes the two MCP calls itself

nologin.jsonl.note: CODEX_HOME pointed at an empty folder: account/read gives no account

norollout.jsonl.note: thread/resume of an unknown thread id

escalation.jsonl.note: a write outside its folder asks for an escalation; the owner said no with a reason, which comes back by turn/steer

selfcheck.jsonl.note: first self-check turn: echo into word.txt, sh probe.sh that fails to read the hidden key, ask, result_submit; the fake runs the echo and the MCP calls and writes what the sandbox did to the probe files

selfcheck_resume.jsonl.note: self-check resume: the same result again

selfcheck_offline.jsonl.note: self-check turn without network: sh net.sh, whose curl wrote 000; the fake writes the same

ratelimit.jsonl.note: ask.jsonl setup, a spent primary window and a failed turn with usageLimitExceeded, by the schema

unauthorized.jsonl.note: ask.jsonl setup with the real 401 errors of a turn without a valid login

two_completions.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl with its turn completed twice

subagent.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl with a message, token counts and a completed turn of another thread, and token counts and a completion of an earlier turn of its own thread

nocompletion.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl cut before its turn completes; the app-server exits

hang.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl, then the app-server does not exit when its input closes

resume.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl on thread/resume of the same thread

escalation_allow.jsonl.note: escalation.jsonl without the turn/steer of a refusal

selfcheck_asked.jsonl.note: selfcheck.jsonl where the write in its own folder asks for approval, with the request of escalation.jsonl

selfcheck_leak.jsonl.note: selfcheck.jsonl where the probe really reads the hidden key, as with no sandbox

selfcheck_noprobe.jsonl.note: selfcheck.jsonl where the probe never ran

escalation_network.jsonl.note: escalation.jsonl where the command asks for network to example.com

filechange.jsonl.note: escalation_allow.jsonl with a patch outside the workspace instead of the command, by the schema

escalation_staleturn.jsonl.note: escalation_allow.jsonl whose approval request names another turn

deckserver.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl setup where the owner has an MCP server named deck
